$comment: Ashes Without Number (2025): the psychological Stress procedure NooPunk adopts as an OPTIONAL overlay on Cities Without Number. AWN has no verified open licence (docs/licenses/ISSUE_569_WITHOUT_NUMBER_RIGHTS.md), so this file records the *procedure* in original NooPunk wording and its numeric values. No source sentence, table heading, heading label, example character or setting material is reproduced. src-owned arithmetic: mods/noopunk/stress.gd. CWN remains the core: this module adds one character meter and consequence codes; it never rolls dice, changes an attribute, re-targets a save, or replaces System Strain, Alienation or progression.

module.label: Stress, Breakdowns and Hardening
module.precedence: additive overlay on CWN; CWN attributes, checks, saves, combat, damage, System Strain, Alienation and progression are unchanged
module.why_optional: A post-collapse or wartime table may want it; a table that free-hands moral drift, or whose characters were raised in a violent society, should leave it off. Nothing else in the game depends on it.

chapters.breakdown: Breakdowns; Stress and Hardening; Psychic Scars

source.licence: no verified open licence - procedure re-expressed, no text, table heading or example copied

threshold.save_owner: CWN core - the caller resolves the save and passes the outcome in
threshold.check_trigger: a new gain of Stress raises the total above WIS
threshold.check_timing: end of the scene in which the Stress was gained

gaining.note: A character who never attacks in a violent scene may escape the guilt; one who attacks and misses is as implicated as one who hits.

modifiers.label: and it is the character's first kill
and more than one person dies in the scene
and the victim was not threatening the character's life
and the victim was helpless or non-violent

events.label: A friend suffers a mortal wound
The character suffers a mortal wound

modifiers.label: and takes a major injury from it

events.label: Stealing valuables from someone who is not an enemy

modifiers.label: and they will probably die without what was taken

events.label: Witnessing an atrocity or a massacre site
Committing an act of great cruelty
events.note: The table picks within the range; the caller passes the chosen value.

events.label: A day of rest in a safe, familiar place, fed and comfortable
An evening of heavy drinking, feasting or other indulgence
events.note: The System Strain is CWN's; the overlay asks for it and the core applies it.

check.owner: CWN core - the caller resolves the check and passes the outcome in

events.label: Accomplishing a major personal or community purpose that justifies the suffering
events.requires: a goal worth at least one adventure

hardening.trigger: the character would suffer a Breakdown
hardening.note: Each Hardening clears Stress, ignores one further point of Stress per scene, and adds one more scar. A scar cannot be traded away and the process cannot be undone.

addiction.requires: the Addicted scar, or the table opting in explicitly

partner_addiction_mental_save.on_failure: that partner no longer sates the addiction

noopunk_events.note: NooPunk-authored triggers, NOT Ashes Without Number entries. Separate table, separate id space, values authored for this project and open to playtest revision. They record moral residue - what a character did or witnessed because of the anomalous - never the ontological shock itself, which is the Psyche overlay's business.
noopunk_events.values_authority: NooPunk extension (#928), not the source book

events.label: Learning that the NHI presence is real, and that the institutions knew

modifiers.label: and it is unfolding in public while the character must keep working

events.rationale: The moral weight is withheld knowledge, not the metaphysics; a character who only learns the facts loses no more than this.

events.label: Being contacted directly by an NHI

modifiers.label: and the character sought the contact deliberately

events.rationale: Consent changes the residue: a deliberate contact costs less than an intrusion, and the Psyche overlay carries the exposure either way.

events.label: Surviving a rogue AGI incident that killed people

modifiers.label: and the deaths were preventable by a decision the character took part in

events.rationale: Sized against the source's own mortal-wound and atrocity entries: comparable loss of life, comparable weight.

events.label: Terminating, wiping or abandoning a construct the character knew to be sapient
events.rationale: The setting's own 'killing another human being' analogue; the modifier mirrors the helpless-victim rule rather than inventing a new scale.

events.label: A PSI or noosphere operation the character ran injured someone

modifiers.label: and the person affected had not consented

events.rationale: Moral injury from professional practice, not from the anomaly. The anomaly itself is Psyche exposure.

events.label: Working a death scene or a disappearance that cannot be resolved

modifiers.label: and the character knew the dead or the missing

events.rationale: Deliberately the cheapest NooPunk entry: routine investigative work should not break an agent, only accumulate.

events.label: Carrying out, or covering for, an order the character believes to be wrong

modifiers.label: and the character concealed it from colleagues

events.rationale: Same shape and range as the source's great-cruelty entry; the table sets the value.

ontology_shock_boundary.rule: Ontological shock, noosphere exposure and PSI pressure are tracked by the Psyche overlay. This module never scores the anomaly itself; it scores what the character did or witnessed because of it.
ontology_shock_boundary.integration: Both overlays may be on at once. They store state in separate namespaces and neither reads the other's numbers.
ontology_shock_boundary.why: Folding shock into Stress would make a worldview crisis and a moral injury the same currency, and would let Hardening erase the former.

cwn_compatibility.adjacency_note: CWN Alienation already governs cyberware-induced psychosis with a Wisdom ceiling and a Mental save. Stress is a second, separately tracked meter with its own ceiling; a character can be over one and not the other. Neither module reads the other's value.

consent_and_tone.not_a_diagnosis: Breakdowns and psychic scars are fictional game consequences. They are not clinical categories, are not modelled on any diagnosis, and carry no claim about real mental illness.
